name: pandas-studio
description: Multi-CLI agent team patterns from pandas-studio's YouTube series. Each plugin packages a Claude-as-conductor pattern with companion CLIs (Gemini, Codex) playing specialised roles.

plugins.name: dev-trio
plugins.description: Claude PM orchestrates a 3-vendor dev team: Gemini (Researcher) + Codex (Reviewer). Three-pane tmux view; bootstrap + research + review + install-pm skills.

plugins.name: debate-conductor
plugins.description: Claude conducts a Generator(Gemini) vs Critic(Codex) adversarial debate over N rounds. Three-pane tmux view; bootstrap + run + continue skills.

plugins.name: ralph-trio
plugins.description: Ralph Wiggum loops — solo / trio / debate / meta variants. Iterative LLM-driven coder loop with planner+coder+reviewer (trio + meta depend on dev-trio; debate depends on debate-conductor). Optional Stop-hook in-session driver for solo.

plugins.name: spec-trio
plugins.description: Spec-anchored ralph-trio: external spec.md gates planner / coder / reviewer with allowlist scope checks + §-citation coverage. Depends on dev-trio for ask-codex.sh (reviewer) and ask-gemini.sh (researcher).
